body:
**Triage: `pm:queue` · `domain:spec-tooling`** — labels only, no claim. Not release-blocking.

## Landing site (read on `origin/main` @ `b7d3be4`, not a worktree)

Both halves of the mechanism confirmed on the ref:

- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/file-description.ts:390` — the bare-path rewrite is `/(?<!\()((?:\.\.\/)*\b[\w-]+\/[\w.-]+\.zod\.ts)\b(?!\))/g`. The `[\w-]+/` group is **mandatory**, so a same-directory filename never matches, and there is no fallback arm — it falls through as plain prose.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts:288` — `sourcePathToDocsRoute()` requires the same slash and reads the first segment as the category.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-docs.ts:423` — `renderFileDescription(…, { sourcePathToDocsRoute })`. This is the root cause stated in the body, verified rather than assumed: the context object is passed **one** member, so `FileDescriptionContext` (`file-description.ts:110`) is never told which file it is rendering, while `build-docs.ts` iterates by category and does know. The adjacent seam the body points at is real too — `schemaHrefFrom(fromCategory)` at `:275`, threaded into `TypeContext` at `:337`.

Spot-check of the reported occurrences (not all nine re-counted; two source files sampled):

- `packages/spec/src/identity/identity.zod.ts:11` writes `auth.zod.ts` bare — and `content/docs/references/identity/identity.mdx:13` carries it through as **plain text**, exactly as described.
- `packages/spec/src/system/security-context.zod.ts:16,18,20` write `audit.zod.ts` / `encryption.zod.ts` / `masking.zod.ts` bare.

Control probe against "the scanner is broken": the same file at `identity.zod.ts:150` writes `api/auth.zod.ts` **with** a category segment, which the regex does match — so the failure is the path shape, not the scan.

## Routing rationale

`packages/spec/scripts/**` is the machinery **around** the contract, not the contract's own text and not its accepted set: this changes how descriptions render, never which metadata validates. That is `domain:spec-tooling` by the standing spec split — same seat as **#6420**, its sibling in the same rewrite step, and same family as #5873 (`build-schemas.ts`).

## Direction — route A ruled here

Route **A** (add `fromCategory` to `FileDescriptionContext`, passed by `build-docs.ts`). It reuses the seam `schemaHrefFrom(fromCategory)` already established at `:275`, and it invents no new rule. Route **B** (search all categories for a bare filename) reintroduces "a bare name is an identity", which #4696 explicitly rejected and which collides on same-named files across categories — a dev preferring B must stop and escalate rather than substitute. The body already leans A; this is that lean made binding, so the interface question does not need to sit in the maintainer's inbox.

One point the implementer must not lose: **5 of the 9 targets have no published page**, so widening the match alone would emit dead links. Those five fall back to a **code span** per the #6229 rule (no page ⇒ no link). Plain text is the only wrong outcome of the three; the acceptance criterion is "no occurrence stays plain text", not "all nine become links".

Out of scope, as the body states and this seat agrees: `security/permission.mdx:134` and `ui/page.mdx:111` are schema-level descriptions rendered by `lib/escape-mdx.ts`, which does no path rewriting at all. Separate face, separate card if anyone wants it.

## Dedup

Repo-scoped searches (global `/search/issues` is proxy-blocked) on `sourcePathToDocsRoute`, `file-description`, bare-source-path wording, across the three repos:

- **#6420** (`pm:dispatched` · `domain:spec-tooling`) — the parenthesis position class. **Not a duplicate**: it deletes the lookaround pair, this one changes the path shape and the `FileDescriptionContext` parameter contract. The bodies agree they are zero-overlap and neither blocks the other; verified against the regex above, where the `(?<!\()`/`(?!\))` pair and the `[\w-]+/` group are independent conditions.
- **#6224** — the earlier landed pass this residue survives from.
- **#6229** — the "no page ⇒ code span, not a link" rule cited above; a constraint, not a duplicate.

Nothing else open claims this rewrite step.

## Serialization note for the `spec-tooling` lane

⚠️ **#6420 is in flight and edits the same two files** (`file-description.ts`, `build-docs.ts`) — indeed the same rewrite step. These two must **not** ride in the same batch: land #6420 first, then rebase this one onto it. Not marked `Blocked-by:` because there is no dependency of substance, only a file collision.

## Release board

No `target:v17`. A published reference page renders a filename as prose instead of a link or a code span — a presentation blemish on the "improvement" side of the release bar, with nothing a reader copies from the docs failing as a result. Same call as its sibling #6420, which carries no release label either.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**认领 · `domain:spec-tooling` 座位派单**

- 会话:`session_01AZgRyPVwi1jLb1mNNuUQ9o`(座位贴 #6018,program card #5163)
- 分支:`claude/issue-6484-same-dir-bare-path-fromcategory`
- `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`。

**串行前置已解除(条件式)**:分诊 01:54Z 的串行提示(「#6420 先落地,本单再 rebase 到它上面」)本座位照办 —— #6420 的 PR **#6491 已验收通过、CI 26/26 全绿、已开启自动合并进入合并队列**。派单里写明:实施座位建分支前必须先确认 `origin/main` 上 `file-description.ts` 的前后瞻对**已消失**(即 #6491 已落地);若尚未落地则等队列,不得从旧 main 起手 —— 两单同文件同改写步骤,从旧基线起手必然产生假冲突。

**接口取向不再是待定项**:分诊已把**路线 A**(给 `FileDescriptionContext` 加 `fromCategory`,由 `build-docs.ts` 传入,复用 `:275` 的 `schemaHrefFrom(fromCategory)` 那道现成的缝)定为有约束力;路线 B(裸名全分类搜索)重新引入 #4696 明确拒绝过的「裸名即身份」并会撞同名文件,**倾向 B 的实施者必须停下上报,不得自行替换**。本座位不推翻该裁决。

**验收判据按分诊原话钉死**:9 处里 **5 处目标页并不存在**,所以判据是「**没有一处仍以纯文本落地**」,而不是「九处全都成链接」—— 那 5 处按 #6229 的规矩回退成**代码段**。纯文本是三种结果里唯一错的那种。

**范围外不碰**:`security/permission.mdx:134` 与 `ui/page.mdx:111` 属 `lib/escape-mdx.ts` 的 schema 级 description 管线,不做任何路径改写,是相邻但独立的一面。

**车道纪律**:本单落地前,本座位不再派出任何需要全语料重生成的卡(#6374 已按此挂起),同一时刻只允许一个重生成面在飞。
